cases: Non-file timer destination leaves the original SUBMITTING delivery, queue bytes and witness untouched

Missing original witness refuses restoration before the browser observer
A witnessed exact receipt restores its missing timer, then a separate fresh response observation completes it
Existing complete timers, failure handling and unrelated project scheduling remain covered
